title: The Johns Hopkins Foreign Affairs Symposium Presents: The Price of Privacy: Re-Evaluating the NSA
summary: A Johns Hopkins Foreign Affairs Symposium debate between former NSA and CIA director Michael Hayden and constitutional law professor David Cole, moderated by Major Garrett. They argue over NSA surveillance, its constitutionality and the balance between privacy and security.
why: Used mainly as a source for Hayden's remarks that the 'nothing to hide' argument is a bad one, in privacy threads.

quote.text: It's a horrible argument. As Americans, we deserve that private space.
